dsh-cgss-idol-theme README · dsh-cgss-idol-theme：[English](README.en.md) · [展示页](https://alycestocking.github.io/dsh-cgss-idol-theme/)

给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/)（DSH）使用的《偶像大师 灰姑娘女孩》多角色主题：**Web 页面主题 + Windows 独立桌宠**。默认角色为佐城雪美，也可搜索姓名或罗马字切换角色。

本仓库在原 `dsh-yukimi-theme` 中合入 `dsh-idol-theme` 后更名而来，保留双方共同历史和多角色开发提交；不再是单独的雪美主题或双角色试验副本。当前包名是 `dsh-cgss-idol-theme`，内部插件条目是 `cgss-idol-theme`。

dsh-cgss-idol-theme README · 功能与覆盖范围：- **空白底板修复（1.3.4）**：修复思考时出现的空白小框和新会话顶部的半透明空栏；保留状态提示、布局按钮及正常标题/标签页，兼容浅色/深色与宽屏/窄屏。详见[验证记录](docs/empty-surfaces-validation.md)。

- **桌宠启动修复（1.3.3）**：修复 DSH Electron Host 将有效独立运行时误判为未安装的问题。运行时物理文件检查使用 Electron 的 `original-fs`，保留原有哈希和路径安全检查，不修改全局 ASAR 行为。已有有效 Electron 44.5.1 缓存无需重新下载；更新后需完整重启 Host。

- **偶像查询与收藏（1.3.2）**：Web 面板与 Windows 桌宠均使用单个可搜索下拉框，输入姓名或罗马字即可筛选。点击旁边的五角星收藏当前偶像，已收藏显示橙色实心星；下拉列表为收藏角色加星标并优先排列，组内保持目录顺序。支持方向键、Enter 选择与 Escape 关闭。收藏保存在各自的本地存储中，重开后保留；Web 与桌宠之间不共享收藏。

dsh-cgss-idol-theme README · 功能与覆盖范围：- **角色目录**：列出 190 位偶像，当前 **188 位可选**。向井拓海、村上巴因采集时返回 HTTP 567 暂列为“待收录”，不是断言其没有素材。另有 8 套缺少配套图标元数据的服装暂被排除。详见[收录报告](research/roster/README.md)与[例外清单](research/roster/coverage.json)。
- **素材目录**：可选角色包含 1,850 套服装、7,400 张小人姿态图与 3,702 张 CGSS 背景的 URL。印象色、签名、Mobamas 卡片、贴纸与过场动画按角色数据提供；并非每位角色都有贴纸或过场动画。
- **角色配色与阅读**：强调色和光晕跟随角色印象色，适配浅色/深色；聊天内容、工具和部分管理页面使用半透明磨砂底板，历史记录上下渐隐，输入卡片独立遮挡滚动内容。
- **小人互动**：拖动、单击翻转并显示台词、双击换装、长按打开角色/服装/背景选择。聚焦后可用 Enter/空格互动、菜单键打开设置、Escape 关闭设置。Windows 桌宠的设置是独立可拖动窗口；页面内面板跟随小人，闲置后收起。
- **装饰与布局**：签名水印、可选 Mobamas 轮播（默认关闭），不额外预留装饰侧栏。宽度小于 1100px 或高度小于 640px 时自动隐藏卡片与签名，小人缩小；沉浸模式另有显示规则。
- **纯背景模式**：点击聊天空白背景或按 Alt+I，临时收起侧栏、标题、输入栏和历史记录；再点背景、向上滚轮或按 Esc 恢复。历史消息与交互控件不是普通背景点击区。
- **沉浸阅读模式**：长按历史区域 650 毫秒或按 Alt+Shift+I，收起侧栏、标题与输入栏但保留可滚动的历史记录；再次长按、再次按快捷键或按 Esc 恢复，退出后还原原布局。移动、滚动、改变文字选区会取消长按；按钮、链接、输入控件及宽表格不触发此长按。
- **台词与问候**：点击优先抽取当前服装的中文译文，再回退到公共台词或 `。。。。。`；每个池使用洗牌队列，一轮抽完才重新洗牌，多条台词时避免新一轮首句紧接上一轮末句重复。启动按本机时间问候（11 点前早晨、11–17 点前午间、17 点起深夜场景），切换角色使用“体力已满”场景。均为文字，**没有语音播放，也不是模型生成的对话**。
- **自动台词的平台差异**：Windows 桌宠每 10 分钟尝试一次，翻转中跳过；30% 使用场景台词（有运行任务时“跑步机互动”，否则“体力已满”），其余为普通台词。Web 小人每 5 秒检查：距离上次自动台词至少 10 分钟且页面最近 30 秒有鼠标/键盘活动时触发；30% 使用“体力已满”，不按任务状态选择跑步机场景。

dsh-cgss-idol-theme README · 功能与覆盖范围：图片从 BWiki CDN 在线加载，需要网络。上述覆盖数字来自仓库中的采集快照和结构检查，并不表示已逐张下载验图或逐角色目视验收。**当前运行时实际有 1,843 套服装的专属台词池，共 93,863 条文本**；另 7 套（岛村卯月、黑埼千岁、白雪千夜、涩谷凛、久川飒、本田未央、久川凪的第 1 套）回退到公共台词。188 位可选角色各有 19 条公共/场景台词，共 3,572 条（同源数据，不能相加为两份不同语料）；可选角色中 128 位有贴纸引用、149 位有过场动画引用。原始采集数据的 1,876 个服装块、95,544 条台词及视觉素材总量，不等于筛选后的运行时覆盖。历史收录报告中的旧统计应与这些范围区分。

dsh-cgss-idol-theme README · Windows 桌宠：独立桌宠仅在 **Windows 的 desktop profile** 启动；普通 Web profile 不启动桌面辅助程序。透明窗口可在 DSH 主窗口最小化或隐藏后继续显示，停用插件或退出 Host 时关闭。桌宠就绪后隐藏页面内小人；启动失败时保留页面内小人。

- 监听运行中或仍有等待请求的主会话，不为子代理单独弹提醒。
- 提醒区区分正常结束、失败、中止、需要回答和需要审批，使用当前角色的场景台词，不再统一使用占位文案。正常结束仅指本轮结束，不表示整个项目已完成。
- 询问和审批保留到请求处理完；结束提醒约显示 5 秒，有等待提醒时排队。新提醒触发一次翻转；气泡显示期间维护置顶而不抢键盘焦点。
- 点击气泡唤起 Harness 并定位会话，不会自动回答或批准请求。
- 支持跨显示器拖动、屏幕边界约束和透明空白区域鼠标穿透。小人位置与设置面板位置独立保存。
- 只预热当前角色的当前服装与下一套，最多 8 张；解码缓存有并发与容量上限。换装等待解码，失败时保留原图；设置窗口不批量预热服装。

dsh-cgss-idol-theme README · Windows 桌宠：桌面偏好保存在 `$DSH_HOME/idol-desktop/preferences.json`，并同步到同一 desktop profile 的页面。普通 Web 页面的主题偏好只保留在当前页面，刷新会恢复默认值；偶像收藏单独保存在本地存储中，不随刷新清空。

Host 与辅助程序通过带随机握手的本机命名管道通信，页面使用 DSH 认证 RPC。保留旧 `/yukimi` RPC 与部分内部命名以兼容现有实现；没有新增 TCP 监听端口。传给桌宠的是会话标识、标题、状态和预设台词，不包含聊天正文。

dsh-cgss-idol-theme README · 从旧包迁移：仓库改名不会自动把已安装的旧包依赖改成新包。请在会话空闲时操作，并先备份桌宠偏好：

1. 在“插件”页停用并移除已安装的 `dsh-yukimi-theme` 或 `dsh-idol-theme`，再安装新包。不要同时启用新旧主题，它们共用部分 RPC、样式和存储实现。
2. `dsh-idol-theme` 的 `idol-desktop` 数据目录继续沿用。原雪美版使用 `yukimi-desktop`；本次改名**不自动搬迁该目录**，请保留原文件作为备份，需要时在新主题重新设置。
3. 安装后确认新包总开关和内部 `cgss-idol-theme` 条目均启用，再完整重启对应的 DSH 服务或桌面应用及 Host。

Web profile 可用官方 CLI 移除实际安装的旧包（没有安装的包不必执行）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-yukimi-theme
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-idol-theme
```

dsh-cgss-idol-theme README · 轻量 npm 包（1.3.4）：轻量包包含全部 Web 主题与桌宠代码，**不包含 Electron 二进制**。Web 用户无需安装桌宠运行时；Windows x64 桌宠用户需在安装插件后显式安装运行时。没有 `postinstall`，插件启动也不会自动下载 Electron。

- npm 页面：<https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-cgss-idol-theme>
- 1.3.4 registry tarball：<https://registry.npmjs.org/dsh-cgss-idol-theme/-/dsh-cgss-idol-theme-1.3.4.tgz>
- **npm 可用版本以页面/registry 为准；若指定版本返回 404，请先使用下方 GitHub 安装方式。** 仓库中的版本号不等于 npm 已发布。

按实际使用的 profile 二选一；desktop 安装使用 **DSH Desktop 自带 CLI**：

```sh
dsh-cgss-idol-theme README · Web 主题：dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-cgss-idol-theme@1.3.4

dsh-cgss-idol-theme README · Windows 桌宠（还需下一步安装运行时）：dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-cgss-idol-theme@1.3.4
```

text:

text: dsh-cgss-idol-theme README · 轻量包：显式安装 Windows 桌宠运行时：运行时固定为 Electron **44.5.1 / Windows x64**，保存在 `$DSH_HOME/idol-desktop/runtimes/electron-44.5.1-win32-x64/`（默认 `DSH_HOME` 为 `~/.dsh`），而不是 npx 临时目录。有效的同版本缓存直接复用，不重复下载。当前每次执行 `status`，以及 Host 启动时解析缓存，都会逐文件读取并进行 SHA-256 校验，覆盖整个 Electron 缓存（约几百 MB）；此校验不联网，但每次检查/启动都有磁盘 I/O 成本，并非仅首次验证。安装并用 `status` 确认后，检查插件开关并**完整重启 DSH Desktop 与 Host**；Host 使用固定缓存中的 Electron 运行当前已安装插件的 [desktop/main.cjs](<desktop/main.cjs>)，无需保留 npx 临时目录。

GitHub 源码不包含被 Git 忽略的 Electron 二进制。此完整包流程先打包生成 `desktop/runtime/win32-x64/CGSS Idol Desktop.exe`，仍然保留；不要与轻量包的显式运行时安装混为一谈。仅从 GitHub 安装源码不能保证有独立桌宠可运行。下载失败时可用 `npm run desktop:package -- --electron-zip-dir <目录>` 指定本地 Electron zip 目录。

安装脚本验证完整运行时，把包含 lib、desktop 和 Electron 的不可变压缩包按内容哈希保存到 `$DSH_HOME/idol-desktop/packages/`，再调用 **DSH Desktop 自带 CLI** 更新 desktop profile。请保留归档供后续依赖重装使用；不修改 Harness 程序文件。仅生成包而不安装：`npm run desktop:install -- --bundle-only`。

text:
dsh-cgss-idol-theme README · 开发与验证：- 编辑 `lib/client.js` 中非生成区块迭代页面逻辑；素材与角色数据变更后运行 `npm run build:characters` 和 `npm run build:client`。提交生成产物，保证 GitHub 源码安装可加载。
- `npm run check` 检查语法和生成数据同步；`npm test` 检查主题清理、角色切换、台词、桌宠提醒、偏好、加载竞态、窗口边界和包身份契约。
- `npm run pack:npm` 生成并检查轻量包，拒绝混入 Electron 二进制，并限制压缩包小于 10 MB；完整包仍使用 `desktop:package` 和 `desktop:install -- --bundle-only`。

text: dsh-cgss-idol-theme README · Lightweight package: explicitly install the Windows companion runtime：The runtime is pinned to Electron **44.5.1 / Windows x64**, stored under `$DSH_HOME/idol-desktop/runtimes/electron-44.5.1-win32-x64/` (`DSH_HOME` defaults to `~/.dsh`), not an npx temporary directory. The Host uses Electron from this fixed cache to run [desktop/main.cjs](<desktop/main.cjs>) from the currently installed plugin; retaining an npx temporary directory is unnecessary.

- **纯背景模式**：点击聊天空白背景或按 Alt+I，临时收起侧栏、标题、输入栏和历史记录；再点背景、向上滚轮或按 Esc 恢复。历史消息与交互控件不是普通背景点击区。
- **沉浸阅读模式**：长按历史区域 650 毫秒或按 Alt+Shift+I，收起侧栏、标题与输入栏但保留可滚动的历史记录；再次长按、再次按快捷键或按 Esc 恢复，退出后还原原布局。移动、滚动、改变文字选区会取消长按；按钮、链接、输入控件及宽表格不触发此长按。
- **台词与问候**：点击优先抽取当前服装的中文译文，再回退到公共台词或 `。。。。。`；每个池使用洗牌队列，一轮抽完才重新洗牌，多条台词时避免新一轮首句紧接上一轮末句重复。启动按本机时间问候（11 点前早晨、11–17 点前午间、17 点起深夜场景），切换角色使用“体力已满”场景。均为文字，**没有语音播放，也不是模型生成的对话**。
- **自动台词的平台差异**：Windows 桌宠每 10 分钟尝试一次，翻转中跳过；30% 使用场景台词（有运行任务时“跑步机互动”，否则“体力已满”），其余为普通台词。Web 小人每 5 秒检查：距离上次自动台词至少 10 分钟且页面最近 30 秒有鼠标/键盘活动时触发；30% 使用“体力已满”，不按任务状态选择跑步机场景。

dsh-cgss-idol-theme README · Windows companion：- Monitors live root sessions and outstanding requests; child agents do not get separate notices.
- Distinguishes turn completion, failure, cancellation, questions and approvals using labels and the selected idol's scene dialogue, rather than a uniform placeholder. Turn completion does not mean the entire project is complete.

- Supports multi-monitor dragging, screen bounds and click-through transparent regions. Pet and settings-window positions are saved separately.

A multi-character **Web theme and Windows desktop companion** for [DeepSeek Harness](https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/), featuring idols from THE IDOLM@STER Cinderella Girls. Yukimi Sajo is the default character; search by name or romanization to choose another idol.

dsh-cgss-idol-theme README · dsh-cgss-idol-theme：This is the original `dsh-yukimi-theme` repository with `dsh-idol-theme` integrated and the repository renamed. Shared history and the multi-character development commits are preserved. It is no longer a Yukimi-only theme or a separate two-character trial. The package is `dsh-cgss-idol-theme`; its internal plugin entry is `cgss-idol-theme`.

dsh-cgss-idol-theme README · Features and coverage：- **Empty-surface fixes (1.3.4):** Removes the blank thinking-state box and the translucent bar in new conversations while preserving status text, layout controls, normal titles/tabs, and responsive light/dark styling. See the [validation notes](docs/empty-surfaces-validation.md).

dsh-cgss-idol-theme README · Features and coverage：- **Companion startup fix (1.3.3):** Fixes valid standalone runtimes being reported as missing inside the DSH Electron Host. Physical runtime verification uses Electron `original-fs`, preserving hash and path checks without changing global ASAR behavior. Existing valid Electron 44.5.1 caches can be reused; fully restart the Host after updating.

dsh-cgss-idol-theme README · Features and coverage：- **Idol search and favorites (1.3.2):** Both Web and Windows settings use one searchable dropdown. Filter by name or romanization, and use the five-point star beside it to favorite the current idol. Favorites have an orange filled star, are marked in the dropdown, and appear first while preserving catalog order within each group. Arrow keys, Enter and Escape are supported. Favorites persist in local storage for each surface; Web and desktop favorites are not shared.

dsh-cgss-idol-theme README · Features and coverage：- **190 listed idols, 188 selectable.** Takumi Mukai and Tomoe Murakami remain disabled because the metadata collection returned HTTP 567, not because they are known to lack assets. Eight outfits without matching icon metadata are also excluded. See the [roster report](research/roster/README.md) and [coverage exceptions](research/roster/coverage.json).
- **Asset catalog:** 1,850 selectable outfits, 7,400 petit poses and 3,702 CGSS background URLs. Character colors, signatures, Mobamas cards, stickers and transition animations are used where available; not every idol has a sticker or animation.
- **Character styling:** impression-color accents and glows, light/dark adaptation, translucent frosted reading surfaces, fading history edges and a separate composer surface.
- **Pet interaction:** drag, single-click to flip and show text, double-click to change outfits, or long-press for character/outfit/background settings. Enter/Space interact, the menu key opens settings, and Escape closes them. Desktop settings use a separate draggable window; the in-page panel follows the pet and closes after inactivity.
- **Decorations:** signature wa

dsh-cgss-idol-theme README · Features and coverage：Images load online from the BWiki CDN and require connectivity. These counts describe the checked-in metadata snapshot, not a download/visual audit of every image or idol. **The runtime actually contains 1,843 outfit-specific dialogue pools with 93,863 lines.** Seven outfits (outfit 1 for Uzuki Shimamura, Chitose Kurosaki, Chiyo Shirayuki, Rin Shibuya, Hayate Hisakawa, Mio Honda and Nagi Hisakawa) fall back to common dialogue. Each of the 188 selectable idols has 19 common/scene lines, totaling 3,572 (the same source data, not two distinct corpora to add together). Among selectable idols, 128 have sticker references and 149 have transition-animation references. The raw collection of 1,876 outfit blocks, 95,544 lines and its visual-asset totals is not the filtered runtime coverage; distinguish these scopes when consulting historical reports.

dsh-cgss-idol-theme README · Windows companion：The separate companion starts only in the **desktop profile on Windows**; an ordinary Web profile does not launch it. The transparent window remains when the main DSH window is minimized or hidden, and closes when the plugin is disabled or the Host exits. The in-page pet hides only after the companion is ready; it remains available if startup fails.

dsh-cgss-idol-theme README · Windows companion：- Monitors live root sessions and outstanding requests; child agents do not get separate notices.
- Distinguishes turn completion, failure, cancellation, questions and approvals using labels and the selected idol's scene dialogue, rather than a uniform placeholder. Turn completion does not mean the entire project is complete.
- Questions/approvals remain until settled. Terminal notices last about five seconds and queue behind outstanding requests. Each new notice triggers one flip; visible notices maintain topmost positioning without taking keyboard focus.
- Clicking a bubble opens the corresponding Harness session; it does not answer or approve anything.
- Supports multi-monitor dragging, screen bounds and click-through transparent regions. Pet and settings-window positions are saved separately.
- Warms only the current and next outfit for the current idol (up to eight poses), with bounded decoding concurrency/cache size. Outfit changes wait for decoding; failure preserves the current image. The settings window does not batch-preload outfits.

dsh-cgss-idol-theme README · Windows companion：Desktop preferences live at `$DSH_HOME/idol-desktop/preferences.json` and sync to pages in the same desktop profile. Ordinary Web theme preferences live only in the current page and reset on refresh; idol favorites are stored separately in local storage and survive refreshes.

dsh-cgss-idol-theme README · Windows companion：Host/helper communication uses a local named pipe with a random handshake; pages use authenticated DSH RPC. The legacy `/yukimi` RPC and some internal names remain for compatibility. No additional TCP listener is opened. The helper receives session identifiers, titles, status and preset lines—not chat message bodies.

text: dsh-cgss-idol-theme README · Lightweight package: explicitly install the Windows companion runtime：The runtime is pinned to Electron **44.5.1 / Windows x64**, stored under `$DSH_HOME/idol-desktop/runtimes/electron-44.5.1-win32-x64/` (`DSH_HOME` defaults to `~/.dsh`), not an npx temporary directory. The Host uses Electron from this fixed cache to run [desktop/main.cjs](<desktop/main.cjs>) from the currently installed plugin; retaining an npx temporary directory is unnecessary.

dsh-cgss-idol-theme README · 功能与覆盖范围：- **空白底板修复（1.3.4）**：修复思考时出现的空白小框和新会话顶部的半透明空栏；保留状态提示、布局按钮及正常标题/标签页，兼容浅色/深色与宽屏/窄屏。详见[验证记录](docs/empty-surfaces-validation.md)。

dsh-cgss-idol-theme README · 功能与覆盖范围：- **角色目录**：列出 190 位偶像，当前 **188 位可选**。向井拓海、村上巴因采集时返回 HTTP 567 暂列为“待收录”，不是断言其没有素材。另有 8 套缺少配套图标元数据的服装暂被排除。详见[收录报告](research/roster/README.md)与[例外清单](research/roster/coverage.json)。
- **素材目录**：可选角色包含 1,850 套服装、7,400 张小人姿态图与 3,702 张 CGSS 背景的 URL。印象色、签名、Mobamas 卡片、贴纸与过场动画按角色数据提供；并非每位角色都有贴纸或过场动画。
- **角色配色与阅读**：强调色和光晕跟随角色印象色，适配浅色/深色；聊天内容、工具和部分管理页面使用半透明磨砂底板，历史记录上下渐隐，输入卡片独立遮挡滚动内容。
- **小人互动**：拖动、单击翻转并显示台词、双击换装、长按打开角色/服装/背景选择。聚焦后可用 Enter/空格互动、菜单键打开设置、Escape 关闭设置。Windows 桌宠的设置是独立可拖动窗口；页面内面板跟随小人，闲置后收起。

- **沉浸阅读模式**：长按历史区域 650 毫秒或按 Alt+Shift+I，收起侧栏、标题与输入栏但保留可滚动的历史记录；再次长按、再次按快捷键或按 Esc 恢复，退出后还原原布局。移动、滚动、改变文字选区会取消长按；按钮、链接、输入控件及宽表格不触发此长按。

dsh-cgss-idol-theme README · dsh-cgss-idol-theme：[中文说明](README.md) · [Showcase](https://alycestocking.github.io/dsh-cgss-idol-theme/)

A multi-character **Web theme and Windows desktop companion** for [DeepSeek Harness](https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/), featuring idols from THE IDOLM@STER Cinderella Girls. Yukimi Sajo is the default character; search by name or romanization to choose another idol.

dsh-cgss-idol-theme README · dsh-cgss-idol-theme：This is the original `dsh-yukimi-theme` repository with `dsh-idol-theme` integrated and the repository renamed. Shared history and the multi-character development commits are preserved. It is no longer a Yukimi-only theme or a separate two-character trial. The package is `dsh-cgss-idol-theme`; its internal plugin entry is `cgss-idol-theme`.

dsh-cgss-idol-theme README · Features and coverage：- **Empty-surface fixes (1.3.4):** Removes the blank thinking-state box and the translucent bar in new conversations while preserving status text, layout controls, normal titles/tabs, and responsive light/dark styling. See the [validation notes](docs/empty-surfaces-validation.md).

dsh-cgss-idol-theme README · Features and coverage：- **Companion startup fix (1.3.3):** Fixes valid standalone runtimes being reported as missing inside the DSH Electron Host. Physical runtime verification uses Electron `original-fs`, preserving hash and path checks without changing global ASAR behavior. Existing valid Electron 44.5.1 caches can be reused; fully restart the Host after updating.

dsh-cgss-idol-theme README · Features and coverage：- **Idol search and favorites (1.3.2):** Both Web and Windows settings use one searchable dropdown. Filter by name or romanization, and use the five-point star beside it to favorite the current idol. Favorites have an orange filled star, are marked in the dropdown, and appear first while preserving catalog order within each group. Arrow keys, Enter and Escape are supported. Favorites persist in local storage for each surface; Web and desktop favorites are not shared.

dsh-cgss-idol-theme README · Features and coverage：- **190 listed idols, 188 selectable.** Takumi Mukai and Tomoe Murakami remain disabled because the metadata collection returned HTTP 567, not because they are known to lack assets. Eight outfits without matching icon metadata are also excluded. See the [roster report](research/roster/README.md) and [coverage exceptions](research/roster/coverage.json).
- **Asset catalog:** 1,850 selectable outfits, 7,400 petit poses and 3,702 CGSS background URLs. Character colors, signatures, Mobamas cards, stickers and transition animations are used where available; not every idol has a sticker or animation.
- **Character styling:** impression-color accents and glows, light/dark adaptation, translucent frosted reading surfaces, fading history edges and a separate composer surface.
- **Pet interaction:** drag, single-click to flip and show text, double-click to change outfits, or long-press for character/outfit/background settings. Enter/Space interact, the menu key opens settings, and Escape closes them. Desktop settings use a separate draggable window; the in-page panel follows the pet and closes after inactivity.
- **Decorations:** signature wa

dsh-cgss-idol-theme README · Features and coverage：Images load online from the BWiki CDN and require connectivity. These counts describe the checked-in metadata snapshot, not a download/visual audit of every image or idol. **The runtime actually contains 1,843 outfit-specific dialogue pools with 93,863 lines.** Seven outfits (outfit 1 for Uzuki Shimamura, Chitose Kurosaki, Chiyo Shirayuki, Rin Shibuya, Hayate Hisakawa, Mio Honda and Nagi Hisakawa) fall back to common dialogue. Each of the 188 selectable idols has 19 common/scene lines, totaling 3,572 (the same source data, not two distinct corpora to add together). Among selectable idols, 128 have sticker references and 149 have transition-animation references. The raw collection of 1,876 outfit blocks, 95,544 lines and its visual-asset totals is not the filtered runtime coverage; distinguish these scopes when consulting historical reports.

dsh-cgss-idol-theme README · Windows companion：The separate companion starts only in the **desktop profile on Windows**; an ordinary Web profile does not launch it. The transparent window remains when the main DSH window is minimized or hidden, and closes when the plugin is disabled or the Host exits. The in-page pet hides only after the companion is ready; it remains available if startup fails.

dsh-cgss-idol-theme README · Windows companion：- Monitors live root sessions and outstanding requests; child agents do not get separate notices.
- Distinguishes turn completion, failure, cancellation, questions and approvals using labels and the selected idol's scene dialogue, rather than a uniform placeholder. Turn completion does not mean the entire project is complete.
- Questions/approvals remain until settled. Terminal notices last about five seconds and queue behind outstanding requests. Each new notice triggers one flip; visible notices maintain topmost positioning without taking keyboard focus.
- Clicking a bubble opens the corresponding Harness session; it does not answer or approve anything.
- Supports multi-monitor dragging, screen bounds and click-through transparent regions. Pet and settings-window positions are saved separately.
- Warms only the current and next outfit for the current idol (up to eight poses), with bounded decoding concurrency/cache size. Outfit changes wait for decoding; failure preserves the current image. The settings window does not batch-preload outfits.

dsh-cgss-idol-theme README · Windows companion：Desktop preferences live at `$DSH_HOME/idol-desktop/preferences.json` and sync to pages in the same desktop profile. Ordinary Web theme preferences live only in the current page and reset on refresh; idol favorites are stored separately in local storage and survive refreshes.

dsh-cgss-idol-theme README · Windows companion：Host/helper communication uses a local named pipe with a random handshake; pages use authenticated DSH RPC. The legacy `/yukimi` RPC and some internal names remain for compatibility. No additional TCP listener is opened. The helper receives session identifiers, titles, status and preset lines—not chat message bodies.

dsh-cgss-idol-theme README · Migrating from the old packages：Renaming the GitHub repository does not automatically rename existing profile dependencies. Work while sessions are idle and back up your companion preferences first.

dsh-cgss-idol-theme README · Migrating from the old packages：1. Disable and remove any installed `dsh-yukimi-theme` or `dsh-idol-theme` through the Plugins page before installing the new package. Do not enable old and new themes together: they share parts of the RPC, CSS and storage implementation.
2. Existing `dsh-idol-theme` preferences under `idol-desktop` continue to be used. The older Yukimi-only package used `yukimi-desktop`; this rename **does not automatically migrate that directory**. Keep it as a backup and reconfigure the new theme if needed.
3. Check both the new package switch and its internal `cgss-idol-theme` entry, then fully restart the corresponding DSH service or desktop application and Host.

dsh-cgss-idol-theme README · Migrating from the old packages：For a Web profile, remove only the old packages actually installed:

~~~sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-yukimi-theme
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-idol-theme

section: Lightweight package: explicitly install the Windows companion runtime

text: dsh-cgss-idol-theme README · Lightweight package: explicitly install the Windows companion runtime：The runtime is pinned to Electron **44.5.1 / Windows x64**, stored under `$DSH_HOME/idol-desktop/runtimes/electron-44.5.1-win32-x64/` (`DSH_HOME` defaults to `~/.dsh`), not an npx temporary directory. A valid cache of the same version is reused without downloading again. Currently, every `status` check and every Host startup that resolves the cache reads and SHA-256-verifies each file across the entire Electron cache (roughly several hundred MB). This verification is offline, but incurs disk I/O on every check/startup, not just the first validation. After installation and verification with `status`, check activation switches and **fully restart DSH Desktop and its Host**. The Host uses Electron from this fixed cache to run [desktop/main.cjs](<desktop/main.cjs>) from the currently installed plugin; retaining an npx temporary directory is unnecessary.
